This appears to be a CBP ruling on an electronic bidet toilet seat. Candidate headings are 3922.20 (plastic toilet seats and covers), 8479.89 (machines with individual functions), 9021 (orthopedic appliances and aids for disabilities), and 8424.89 (spraying appliances).

Heading 9021 covers appliances worn or carried to compensate for a defect or disability. A toilet-mounted bidet is neither worn nor carried, and the description says it performs the same functions as a general-purpose bidet. That rules out 9021. Chapter 39 notes cover plastic seats, but this is an electromechanical device with a control panel and water spray, so 8479 fits better.

I recall CBP ruling N-series cases classifying electronic bidet seats in 8479.89.9499, though some were put in 3922.20. Electronic bidet seats with heating and water pumps have been classified under 8479.89.94. I'll go with that.

The 8479.89 subheadings: 8479.89.94 is "Other" machines, and 8479.89.9499 is "Other." A 2022 revision may have changed this to 8479.89.9599, but 8479.89.9499 is the better-known number.

{"hts_code": "8479.89.9499", "reason": "The electronic bidet toilet seat is a machine with individual functions not specified elsewhere, and because it performs the same functions as a general-purpose bidet and is not worn or carried, it does not qualify for heading 9021."}
